rules.return_label: A one-minute kline opened at t-1 is labelled at boundary t, when that kline is fully closed and observable. Close-to-close return r_t therefore uses only closes observable by t.
rules.decision_information: A decision stamped t may read return rows through t and no later row.
rules.latency_interpretation: The t+1 entry boundary intentionally excludes the one-step return from t to t+1. Experiment 0015 tests whether the cross-sectional rank persists into the following ten-minute holding interval; it does not claim to capture the already elapsed forecast minute.
rules.execution_reference: For each required symbol and entry or exit boundary, use the first verified aggregate trade whose transact_time is on or after the boundary.
rules.delay_failure: If any required symbol has no aggregate trade within 60000 milliseconds after a boundary, reject the complete UTC day rather than forward-fill or substitute a kline price.
rules.shared_boundary: An unchanged symbol must use the identical aggregate-trade price for the expiring and new target at a shared rebalance boundary.
